thread:
maria: Hey @security-team — I need a short admin window (~30m) to run a config migration that updates connector TLS settings across accounts. JIRA RED-3452. Proposed time: 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC (can shift). Can I get a quick approval and any required constraints? TL;DR: non-breaking, cert thumb rotation + cipher alignment.
ajay: quick q — is this going to touch PII logs or require any data redaction?
maria: No PII. It's only connector metadata and cert thumbprints. Logs will show connector IDs and statuses, no request payloads. Plan (short):
```
# dry-run first
./scripts/migrate-connectors.sh --env prod --dry-run --batch-size 50
# apply when dry-run clean
./scripts/migrate-connectors.sh --env prod --apply --batch-size 200
```
Rollback is a simple re-sync using the saved config snapshot: `./scripts/restore-connector-config --snapshot $SNAP_ID`
jamie: Need justification + exact timeframe + who will be oncall during the window. Also: require ephemeral admin token, audit logging enabled, and verbose connector logs for 1h post-change.
maria: Justification: expiring certs and compliance-driven cipher parity. Oncall: ajay + luis. Duration requested: 22:00-22:30 UTC (30m) + 1h monitoring. I'll request the ephemeral token and paste grant id here.
security-bot: Please submit the temporary-admin-access form: https://redwood/internal/forms/temp-admin — include JIRA, planned rollback steps, and oncall names. Also ensure KMS unwrap + audit events are enabled for the window.
luis: I can be oncall and watch metrics. If errors spike I'll revert routing and rollback.
ajay: I can help coordinate traffic and validations. Will watch traces.
jamie: Approved with conditions: submit the form, use ephemeral token only (no long-lived creds), enable verbose connector logs for 1h after change, and do not run during backup window 22:30-23:15 UTC. Approval window: 22:00-22:45 UTC. Reply 'ack' here to confirm.
maria: ack — form submitted (form-id: TADMIN-9876), ephemeral token request id: ETOK-4321. Audit config: enabled verbose logs + KMS unwrap logging for the window. I will not run during backup window. Will post a short status update when finished. Thanks!
ajay: noted, will stand by and coordinate smoke tests.
security-bot: Audit entry created: AUD-20260318-1761112222. Remember to attach the migration run logs to RED-3452 when done.
